goal: Single-source parametric morphology reconstruction confidence data over type, r39, flux, and source center position.

global_settings.template_normalization: 128 and 64 GT images are independently unit-normalized; LHAASO response flux is controlled only by F0 in ParInit.yaml.

source_center.sampling: independent Gaussian N(0, 0.75 deg), truncated to |Cx|<=1.6 deg and |Cy|<=1.6 deg
source_center.meaning: source morphology center in the image coordinate system, not ROI RA/DEC

response_grid.construction: sum each 2x2 block from the 0.05 deg grid, then independently unit-normalize the 64 grid

response.roi_ra_center_sampling: uniform_[0,360) in response generation; independent from source Cx/Cy
response.flux_source: response configuration F0 only; GT npy templates are unit-normalized

parameter_strategy.flux_coefficients_rule: np.geomspace(0.1, 10.0, 50), endpoints included; written to response F0 as coefficient × 1e-16
parameter_strategy.r39_grid_rule: np.linspace(0.1, 0.5, 20), endpoints included; used as the confidence-map scale axis for GAUSSIAN/DISK/SHELL/DIFFUSION

scale_definitions.POINT: no intrinsic scale parameter; 50 samples over flux only
scale_definitions.GAUSSIAN: scale_r39_deg is converted to sigma_major_deg using circular Gaussian containment r39 = sigma * sqrt(-2 ln(1-0.39)); epsilon and position angle are randomized
scale_definitions.DISK: scale_r39_deg is converted to radius_deg using uniform disk containment r39 = radius * sqrt(0.39)
scale_definitions.SHELL: scale_r39_deg is converted to r_out_deg using the same containment proxy as DISK; r_in_deg is randomized and recorded
scale_definitions.DIFFUSION: scale_r39_deg is used directly as r39_deg; r68_deg is randomized and recorded

parameter_strategy.sample_order: POINT iterates flux. Extended types iterate r39 grid first, then ascending log-spaced flux coefficients.
